_metadata.focus_claim: This artifact gives the Backbond telemetry MVP a deterministic re-pricing trigger that converts signed signal envelopes into Underwriter-consumable multiplier inputs without changing the Backbond score Output.
escalations_noted: No Founder gate: this is additive telemetry trigger logic and does not change the Backbond score Output, pillar weights, rubric points, or filed band mapping.
Suspend semantics approved only with Founder + HoUW co-sign per contracts/telemetry-api-v0.md §4.3.

consumer_notes.underwriter_multiplier_input: event_type_counts and aggregate_severity are sufficient and necessary for f(event_type_counts, aggregate_severity) -> new_multiplier; no reach-back to portal state is required.
consumer_notes.current_backbond_score_ref: Evidence pointer only. It is not an input to this trigger and does not mutate the Backbond score Output.
consumer_notes.retraction_policy: Already-emitted re-pricing events are not rescinded by a later rules revert; downstream Underwriter intake handles superseding events or manual retraction.
